issue.message: The specification requires CHECK-AUTH (`node --test tests/auth.test.mjs`) on the selected candidate, but the tests import `src/api.mjs` which depends on `src/auth.mjs`. Because `src/auth.mjs` is not part of the base snapshot or dependencies for TASK-AUTH-TESTS and is outside the allowed write scopes (tests/auth.test.mjs only), tests cannot execute against the candidate implementation without the auth module dependency or mock adapter.
issue.requestedChange: Provide `src/auth.mjs` as a prerequisite dependency in the task workspace or adjust the map/task dependencies so TASK-AUTH runs after TASK-AUTH-IMPL, or permit writing a mock/stub.

issues.message: TASK-AUTH-TESTS declares a milestone dependency on TASK-AUTH-CODE but does not have an explicit input reference to its outputs. The task cannot access src/auth.mjs at execution time, which is required by the test imports of src/api.mjs.
issues.requestedChange: Add task:TASK-AUTH-CODE:source as an explicit input to TASK-AUTH-TESTS in the implementation-map.json inputs array.
